profile.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ Vendelux | The future of in-person marketing starts here | Helping B2B teams find and win at the events that matter
profile.title: Co-founder & CEO
profile.summary: The best business relationships are built in person. Vendelux exists to make sure you're in the right room when it matters most.Vendelux gives you actionable insights on B2B events so you can identify the right opportunities, show up prepared, and prove the impact afterward. We work directly with 5,000+ event partners to make that possible.Teams at Ramp, Docker, Miro, Glean, Superhuman, and hundreds of others trust Vendelux to make their event programs a predictable part of how they grow.Before Vendelux, I was the VP and GM of Platform Solutions at Shutterstock, building this business unit from zero to 9-figure ARR, a team of 75+, and over 20K platform partners. At that scale, we were spending heavily on events with no real way to know if the right buyers would actually be there, and that's what led me to co-found Vendelux.If events are a serious part of your pipeline, learn more at vendelux.com or reach out directly.

profile.summary: Senior global B2B SaaS marketing and go-to-market executive with a proven track record of scaling pipeline, revenue, and GTM systems through high-growth phases.I specialize in building repeatable, revenue-driven marketing organizations that move companies from early momentum to predictable growth. My experience spans demand generation, GTM strategy, positioning, and sales alignment, with a strong focus on designing operating models that scale across teams, markets, and growth stages.I currently lead Marketing at Vendelux, an AI-powered in-person go-to-market and event intelligence platform. I own marketing strategy, pipeline creation, and revenue alignment across marketing, SDR, and sales teams. My scope includes ICP definition, GTM messaging, demand generation, account-based programs, sales development strategy, and the systems that connect event activity to pipeline and revenue. I work closely with executive leadership to translate growth targets into scalable GTM execution, while reducing dependency on founder or individual heroics.At Vendelux, I have built and scaled the marketing and SDR functions, strengthened alignment with sales, and implemented a revenue-first approach to events, outbound, and inbound demand. I built the marketing function, supported enterprise sales motions, and delivered consistent, measurable pipeline contribution. Earlier in my career, I spent nearly seven years leading global marketing at CEIC Data, reporting directly to the CEO. I built and led an international team across the US, APAC, and EMEA and drove sustained pipeline through demand generation, paid media, and PR, contributing to the company’s $200M+ acquisition.
